page.layout: One printed page, text only, no margin notes. Top: continuation of a poem in italic verse, ending with the signature "I. I. B." at right. Below a double rule: title block centred (DE CVLICE GLOBVLO, subtitle, CARMEN), then "Ad I. Baptistam Rothanum.", then the poem in italic verse. Signature "G. j" at lower right, below the text.

p.i: Gemellíq; senum vident ocelli. Nunc vos luminibus meis misellis Certam fertis opem benigniora Vestris lucidulis specilla flammis. Sic Phoebi, Charitum, & nouem sororum Interesse mihi licet Choreis. Sic clara licet eruditione Semper voluere nobiles libellos.

main_text.head: DE CVLICE GLOBVLO Succino, siue Electro includo, CARMEN,

p.i: SI tecum mihi nunc licet iocari, Et nugas dare nobiles amico, Salésq; innocuos, facetiásq;: Defuncti Culicis, Rothane, Manes Mitto pallidulos minutulósque. Rides? Limpidula videre fas est Iamiam (ni tibi lippiant ocelli) Illos molliter vrnula iacentes: Annosam nec opus tibi Sibillam

page.notes: Signature "G. j" is partly faint; the final letter may be a superscript or a mark, read as "j" with [?] doubt. The opening word of the poem is an italic capital S with a large initial; read as printed. The line "Gemellíq; senum vident ocelli." is partly worn; "senum" is read with some doubt.
